# Table shading versus cell shading

Original control generated by `tools/table_shading_scope_fixture.py`, using
only the project's original OPC shell. No corpus text or artwork is included.
The reference application exported the five-page `native.pdf`; the DOCX
was closed without saving. `tools/table_shading_scope_reference.py` records
source/PDF hashes and samples well inside both cells on each page.

Pages test direct table shading, table-style table shading, cell-style shading
with a direct cell override, conditional table shading, and conditional cell
shading with a direct override. The reference application paints the first, second and fourth pages'
cells white despite orange table shading. Pages three and five have green and
blue cells. This confirms MS-OI29500 §2.1.144(b)'s divergence from ECMA-376
§17.4.32: omitted cell shading follows the cell style, not table-level shading.

Tests exercise import, removing direct shading, conditional recomputation after
row insertion, body editing, export/reopen, unrelated-part preservation and
exact undo. Nonzero cell spacing is outside this control's scope.
